info.name: AnyWorks API Doc
info.description:
This is the API documentation of all AnyWorks Backend Services. It will be updated when more endpoints are completed.

**URI Structure**

All requests are in the form - `https://{{base_url}}/{{service_name}}/{{api_version}}/{{route}}`

> Base URL 
  

**Service Names**

\* `artisan` - Artisan Backend Service  
\* `admin` - Admin Backend Service  
\* `booking` - Booking Backend Service  
\* `user` - User Backend Service

**Response Format**

All response are sent in JSON format and there are 2 types of response:

> Success Response 
  
> Error Response 
  

\* `success` returns **false** when there's an error or **true** if the request was successful. Make sure you check for this value.  
\* `message` returns the response message if the request was success.  
\* `payload` returns the response data if the request was successful, if there's no data to be returned, an empty object will be returned. _**NB**_: All response data will be in _**payload.data**_ and if a token is returned, it will be in _**payload.token**_  
\* `error.type` returns the type of the error  
\* `error.code` returns the standard http error code  
\* `error.message` returns the error message if the request was not successful. _**NB: the message may be a string or array of objects, check the example below.**_

**  
Example Response**

> Error Response 
  
> Success Response 
  

**  
NB**: List of all possible errors can be [found here](https://github.com/Intrapair/anyworks_artisan_service/blob/main/src/utils/constants/httpErrors.ts)

request.description:
There are multiple things to look out for in login response data

*   `verified` - if **false**, a new OTP code would be sent automatically to the artisan email then take them to OTP screen.
*   `profile_stage` - Represent each stage of artisan account creation after they verify their email. If the value is **4** then the artisan has completed all forms, take them to home screen else, take them to the equivalent screen for them to complete their profile setup.
*   `kyc_verified` - If **false**, the admin has not verified their account, artisan should not be able to change their available status but they have access to their home screen and they can update their profile setting.

request.description:
There are multiple things to look out for in login response data

*   `verified` - if **false**, a new OTP code would be sent automatically to the artisan email then take them to OTP screen.
*   `profile_stage` - Represent each stage of artisan account creation after they verify their email. If the value is **4** then the artisan has completed all forms, take them to home screen else, take them to the equivalent screen for them to complete their profile setup.
*   `kyc_verified` - If **false**, the admin has not verified their account, artisan should not be able to change their available status but they have access to their home screen and they can update their profile setting.

item.description:
Push Notification is sent to Artisan device(s) when the following actions are made

- User send a booking request
- User pay invoice
- User cancel booking
- User mark booking as completed
- User cancel booking invoice
    

You do not need to listen to messages from a Topic. The data you will receive when a notification is sent is an object of the type below

`{ event: string, title: string, body: string, payload: string }`

- `event` is the event name example **NEW_BOOKING_REQUEST**
- `title` is the notification title
- `body` is the notification body
- `payload` is the data been sent, most case, it will be the booking id
    

Here's an example of a booking request

`{ event: "NEW_BOOKING_REQUEST", title: "Hello Toheeb", body: "Congratulations, you just received a new booking request 🎉 Tap here to get started", payload: "6342a63ee6f41014672d63dc"}`

**List of all available booking events can be** [**found here**](https://github.com/Intrapair/anyworks_booking_service/blob/main/src/utils/constants/bookingEvents.ts)

Note that, you are to make request to pending booking request once the event come in.

_We may need to change some of this to a TOPIC if you won't be able to implement the logic of making API request if Artisan if not interact with the notification message_

item.description:
Push notification is sent to Customer device(s) when the following are made

- Vendor accept a booking request - Event name: NEW_BOOKING_REQUEST_ACCEPTED
- Vendor reject booking request - Event name: NEW_BOOKING_REQUEST_REJECTED
- Vendor create an invoice - Event name: NEW_BOOKING_INVOICE
- When a payment has been confirmed - Event name: BOOKING_INVOICE_PAID
- When a promotion notification was sent from admin webapp - Event name: PROMOTION (Open notification screen for this)
    

You do not need to listen to messages from a Topic. The data you will receive when a notification is sent is an object of the type below

`{ event: string, title: string, body: string, payload: string }`

- `event` is the event name example **NEW_BOOKING_REQUEST_ACCEPTED**
- `title` is the notification title
- `body` is the notification body
- `payload` is the data been sent, most case, it will be the booking id
    

Here's an example of a booking request

`{ event: "`NEW_BOOKING_REQUEST_ACCEPTED`", title: "`Booking Request Update`", body: "`Congratulations Toheeb, your booking request was accepted 🎉 Proceed to pay the vendor service fee`", payload: "6342a63ee6f41014672d63dc"}`

**List of all available booking events can be** [**found here**](https://github.com/Intrapair/anyworks_booking_service/blob/main/src/utils/constants/bookingEvents.ts)

_We may need to change some of this to a TOPIC if you won't be able to implement the logic of making API request if Artisan if not interact with the notification message_
